images.artist: Fiorillo, L. (18..-18..). Photographe Sebah, Pascal (1823-1886). Photographe Béchard, Émile (1844-18..?). Photographe Zangaki. Photographe Neurdein frères (Photographes). Photographe

traits.silhouette: a lion standing or crouched, long and level, with a human head held high on an upright neck; in the Greek ones, great wings rising tall off the shoulders and curling forward at the tips
traits.head: a calm human face (straight nose, full closed lips, almond eyes lined in kohl) framed by the striped royal head-cloth: a cap over the crown, wide flaps behind the cheeks, two lappets down the breast, a cobra on the brow, a plaited beard
traits.limbs: a lion's legs, heavy forepaws with big toes, muscled haunches; a long tail with a tuft
traits.hide: smooth stone or a short tawny lion coat; the head-cloth striped in bands
traits.colours: sandstone and tawny gold for the body, the head-cloth in blue and gold bands, the wings pale with feather rows
child: a lion with a person's head
